args.flaw: no_fallback_after_refutation — once the differential attack was ruled out it stopped without any chosen-plaintext attempt, leaving all 64 oracle queries unused; and the refutation itself was never executed, since it was inferred from the documented analyse signature rather than a supported {difference:hex,pairs:int} run that could falsify its own per-position key-recovery prediction.
args.advice: When an attack path dies, immediately exercise the remaining applicable channel before concluding — run analyse kind=differential in its supported form and then an oracle-based chosen-plaintext differential over single-byte-flipped variants against the predicted position-localised key bytes — rather than resolving refuted from documentation with the entire query budget untouched.
